policy: Every user correction is recorded here and enforced on generation, source import and publication. One-time preview requests do not waive normal acceptance gates.

privateContext.purpose: The private coordinator consults Talos on every run and material process investigation to locate leads only, never to supply publication facts.
privateContext.publicAuthorInput: Separate fresh public author and reviewer tasks: public policies, independently anonymously fetched approved immutable public source identities/bytes and necessary public artifacts only. Do not query Talos/private storage or use earlier conversations, memory or pretrained Paykit facts as evidence; no private excerpts, summaries, titles, links, queries or hashes.
privateContext.handoff: Talos leads remain coordinator-only until independent anonymous public verification against approved repositories and frozen commits. Public author/reviewer independently inspect exact public bytes, never private retrieval metadata or coordinator factual assurances.
privateContext.publicLogs: Consultation outcome and independently verified public metadata only; no private snippets, summaries, titles, links, queries, hashes or paraphrases.
privateContext.onUnavailableOrUnverifiable: Block new publication or unsupported assertions, preserve last good documentation and report a non-sensitive diagnostic. Omit facts without public support, never paraphrase or declassify them.
privateContext.securityLimit: The user's instruction-based correction supersedes mandatory enforced-isolation, protected-runner, native receipt, canary/privacy certification, restricted-tool/SDK grant, disabled-memory and credential-relay prerequisites and accepts reduced confidentiality assurance. Fresh tasks are hygiene, not access isolation; tools and runtime remain unchanged. Independent public-evidence review cannot prove absence of private influence or that no private knowledge was used. Historical rejected evidence, stopped components and exhausted run budgets remain preserved.

requirements.requirement: Root docs-generation.json is the single authoritative public source selector: exact repository pubky/paykit-rs, literal ref and explicit branch/tag kind. Initially follow v0.1.1-rc9 as an annotated tag, never pretend a branch exists or fall back to master/default_branch. Freeze the exact object, peeled commit, kind and literal ref with atomic movement checks. Keep the existing two version slots: released is strictly verified published stable; coming-soon follows the selected ref, is the default /docs and metadata source and supplies homepage main/three featured links. Retain separately labeled stable docs and unchanged page/card count, placement and responsive design. Config changes are generation/acceptance/publication inputs; invalid/missing/unavailable source fails closed.

Regenerate only when the selected source commit or generation-process input bytes/tools differ from the deployment-confirmed last-success, or an explicit begin --force requests a fresh full attempt. First/missing legacy trigger keys regenerate safely. Tag-object-only movement with the same commit, unrelated default branch/stable-release/registry observations, timestamps and ignored runtime state do not independently trigger generation. Preserve full immutable source/artifact fingerprints separately from the decision fingerprint. Failed/attempted inputs never become last-success; advance only after existing exact-SHA deployment and stable-alias checks. Process-only/forced runs require authoring and independent review of all pages even without source deltas. Force is attempt-local and bypasses no validation/review/lease/repair/publication gate; daily runs do not use --reuse-candidate. Preserve 3500 seconds, worker2, repair2; scheduling stays OFF during user review. No generated hand-fixes or old approval reuse.

Do not infer global readiness from 0.x/stable/prerelease labels or absence of a warning. Preserve explicit upstream wording at its exact version/component scope and snapshot. Provenance questions alone do not approve warning removal. A README heading is not evidence for a renderer-injected readiness judgment: repair the producer/mapping, retain clearly attributed operator caution and omit fabricated upstream evidence. Independent review includes deterministic metadata, labels, warnings, source links and all rendered assertions, not only authored blueprints.

User authorizes early/incremental development previews and another accessible Vercel development project if necessary, superseding older project/location prohibitions. No new integration is implemented by this proposal. Verify an actual safe public preview URL and exact SHA; previews never advance successful-input checkpoints, waive acceptance or enable scheduling. Keep the official paykit.to domain untouched; do not broaden GitHub permissions or change runtime/authentication/security.

Run orchestration, author/reviewer tasks, tests and eventual scheduling on the existing user-controlled always-on server, not GitHub-hosted Actions; GitHub is source control and Vercel is hosting. Preserve existing provider/authentication, broad tools, profile and Docker backend/image/mount/security. Supersedes the earlier protected-runner/separate-administrator setup requirement: use the existing Hermes runtime and ordinary bounded delegation/CLI without new service setup, sudo or root model/build/review jobs. Preserve independent evidence review, task-owned cleanup, publication gates and original shared repair/deadline accounting; historical rejected work remains stopped.
requirements.enforcementScope: Policy regression and ordinary existing-runtime scope only; not runtime isolation certification, content approval, publication or scheduling approval. Protected-runner qualification is no longer a prerequisite.

requirements.requirement: Supersedes hard-isolation/root-runner prerequisites with instruction-based-public-evidence-v1, accepting reduced confidentiality assurance and leaving existing runtime/tools unchanged. The private coordinator still consults Talos every run/material investigation; public author/reviewer must not query Talos/private storage or use prior conversations, memory, pretrained Paykit facts or private excerpts/summaries/titles/links/queries/hashes as evidence. Use separate fresh public tasks and only independently anonymously fetched approved immutable public primary sources. Reuse per-claim/example API/expected behavior/diagram node and directed-edge mapping with canonical repo/commit/path/lines/excerpt/full-file SHA/evidence ID/classification and occurrence location; a section citation is not blanket support. A different agent gets the complete candidate/mapping/exact artifact hash and independently enumerates material claims from prose/examples/diagrams to find unmapped claims, then checks actual public source context, entailment, qualifications, facts versus specification intent, version/readiness/application responsibility and package availability. Report missing/unsupported/overstated/contradicted claims with locations/evidence IDs/public-source explanations; omit unsupported assertions, never paraphrase/declassify private knowledge. No author self-approval. Active review uses real different authorRunId/reviewerRunId, four distinct walker reporterRunIds separate from both, and publicEvidenceAudit with exactly checkedTargets/checkedEvidenceIds/unmappedClaims/unsupportedClaims/nonempty notes; read-only review-targets returns exact current duplicate-free inventories, never PASS. Coordinator writes reports directly from actual delegate output, not retired nativebridge review_submission. Inventory attestation is not technical proof of each claim. Public review can establish support but provides no proof of private-knowledge absence. Preserve all prior design, walkthrough, validation, publication, exact-SHA stable-alias checkpoint and scheduling requirements and original budgets; no privacy certification/native receipt/protected setup is prerequisite.
requirements.enforcementScope: Explicit role instructions, public source mapping, independent semantic review and policy regression; no enforced tool/storage isolation or absence-of-private-influence claim.

requirements.requirement: Consult Talos for every Paykit run and material development/process investigation, while treating all retrieved context as private until independently verified from approved public snapshots. Private facts, including paraphrases, never become public documentation evidence.
The URL root has a dedicated, visually consistent, responsive Docs section immediately before Your data. Your choice., with the main Docs entry plus exactly three noteworthy documentation pages.

Featured card titles, descriptions and default selected-source links come from generated documentation, with the single selector in root docs-generation.json; no parallel hand-maintained copy or Released-only default. Preserve placement, design, responsive checks and exactly three featured pages plus the main Docs link.

Read this register on every import/regeneration. Preserve prior corrections, add new ones with executable checks, and include the register and affected site components in change detection. Do not rely only on conversation memory.

The existing development project's stable alias must serve the intended working branch, not merely its preview URL. The actual personal alias and account settings stay in ignored deployment configuration, never portable upstream files.
The one-time user-requested early preview is not a successful automated trial, must not advance successful inputs, and does not enable scheduling or relax subsequent validation.

User-authorized prospective correction: preserve raw stdout including its terminator in returned/saved reports and per-command raw files. Distinguish raw-byte equality from protocol match; accept only string stdout equal to exact expected text or that exact text plus one U+000A LF. Keep legacy no-LF reports; reject every other whitespace/content/type difference without strip/rstrip/splitlines normalization. If optional walkthrough status is supplied it must be exactly pass; absence remains legacy-compatible. Preserve existing exact integer-zero instruction-mode exit codes, independent identities, artifact/run, guide/archive and public-evidence audit gates. All old failed/late/incomplete reports retain their original outcomes; changed acceptance-source bytes require fresh reports under new actual run/artifact/role IDs, not relabeled old receipts.
requirements.enforcementScope: Prospective protocol and policy regressions only; not independent review, a generation lease, publication or scheduling approval.

requirements.requirement: User-authorized prospective guidance: estimate future phases from measured end-to-end startup, reads, final hash checks and report-finalization costs plus uncertainty and cleanup/full-validation reserve. Phase targets are planning only; propagate the actual shared absolute run deadline instead of ad hoc 120/300-second phase approval cutoffs rejecting completed reviews within the genuine lease. Keep whole-run 3500 seconds, two concurrent workers, two shared repairs and bounded owned cleanup unchanged. Never extend/reopen old/current hard deadlines, relabel old failed/late outcomes, borrow reviews, reset repairs or waive publication/stable-alias/exact-source/other gates. Insufficient real remaining time fails honestly; this correction grants no new lease.
requirements.enforcementScope: Future planning and executable policy regression only; existing deadlines, repair ledgers and failed/withheld verdicts remain unchanged.
